data.name: Mahra
data.gender_notes: Mahra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root m-h-r meaning radiant, shining, bright. In Islamic tradition, Mahra is associated with the light of God and the inner light of the human soul. The name Mahra carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahra usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of the soul and the divine light of God.
data.etymology: Mahra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahra total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مهرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي يعني الفتاة الجميلة أو الحسناء
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهرة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'مهر' التي تعني الفتاة الجميلة أو الحسناء. يعتبر اسم مهرة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالجمال والأنوثة. وقد وردت كلمة 'مهر' في القرآن الكريم في سورة النحل الآية ७٦، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ بَنَاتٍ وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ'، وقد فسر بعض المفسرين أن المهر هنا يشير إلى الجمال والفضل.

in_urdu.name: مہرا
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورت لڑکی، حسین، پیارا، عظیم شرف والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہرا ایک علم مؤنث ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت لڑکی، حسین، پیارا یا عظیم شرف والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور شرافت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ عربی زبان میں 'مهر' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'جمال' یا 'خوبصورتی'، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: महरा
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदर लड़की, अच्छी, प्रिय, महान सम्मान वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: महरा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है सुंदर लड़की, अच्छी, प्रिय या महान सम्मान वाला। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदरता और सम्मान के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। अरबी भाषा में 'महर' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है 'सुंदरता' या 'अच्छाई', और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष रूप से लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: مهړه
in_pashto.meaning: ښایسته نجلۍ، منښت، ګرانه، لوی درناوی لرونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهړه د ښځينو یو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم ښایسته نجلۍ، منښت، ګرانه یا لوی درناوی لرونکې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د ښایست او درناوي د نښانې په توګه کارول کېږي. په عربي ژبه کې د 'مهرو' څخه مشتق شوی دی چې معنی يې 'ښایست' یا 'ګرانه' ده.

in_english.name: Mahra
in_english.meaning: Beautiful girl, lovely, dear, great dignity
in_english.long_meaning: Mahra is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It means 'beautiful girl,' 'lovely,' 'dear,' or 'great dignity.' The name is derived from the Arabic root 'm-h-r,' which conveys meanings related to beauty, loveliness, and nobility. In Islamic tradition, Mahra is associated with positive attributes and is considered a desirable name for girls. The name has historical significance and continues to be used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing beauty, elegance, and high esteem.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahra is most commonly recognized in the Arabian Peninsula and among Arab communities worldwide. In some regions, it is also used as a given name for girls. In cultural context, Mahra can evoke images of beauty, radiance, and shimmering light. It is a desirable and appealing name, evoking a sense of grace and elegance.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Mahra is associated with the divine light that illuminates the human soul. It represents the innate spiritual potential within each individual. The name serves as a constant reminder of the presence of God's light within and the importance of keeping the soul pure and shining bright. Additionally, in Sufism, the path of spiritual seeking is often referred to as the "path of light" and the attainment of spiritual knowledge and illumination as "Mahra-i-Sirr" or "the inner light." Hence, Mahra holds deep significance as a name that represents both the external beauty and the inner light of a person.
